mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.declaration_id AS declarationId,t.declaration_revision AS revision, t.execution_code AS executionCode,t.routing_node_id AS routingNodeId,t.action_type AS action, t.attribution_type AS attribution,t.related_declaration_id AS relatedDeclarationId,t.basis, t.returned_qty AS returnedQty,t.transfer_qty AS transferredQty,d.declaration_id AS ownerDeclarationId FROM mes_quality_treatment t JOIN mes_production_defect d ON t.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND t.declaration_revision=d.revision_no WHERE d.id IN #{id} AND CAST(t.id AS BINARY(128)) > CAST(#{afterId} AS BINARY(128)) ORDER BY CAST(t.id AS BINARY(128)) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT identity_value FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('D:',d.declaration_id,':',d.revision_no) AS identity_value FROM mes_production_defect d WHERE d.execution_code=#{executionCode} AND CAST(d.record_action AS BINARY(32))!=CAST(#{voided} AS BINARY(32)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no>d.revision_no) UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('T:',t.id) AS identity_value FROM mes_quality_treatment t WHERE t.execution_code=#{executionCode} ) identities ORDER BY CAST(identity_value AS BINARY(128))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_production_defect d JOIN mes_quality_treatment t ON t.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND t.declaration_revision=d.revision_no LEFT JOIN () proof ON proof.eventId=t.id WHERE d.execution_code=#{executionCode} AND CAST(d.record_action AS BINARY(32))!=CAST(#{voided} AS BINARY(32)) AND t.action_type=#{transfer} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no>d.revision_no) AND COALESCE(proof.validCount,0)!=1

SELECT d.declaration_id AS declarationId, w.code AS workorderCode, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, w.status AS workorderStatus, e.status AS executionStatus, w.source AS source, e.batch_no AS batchNo, m.specification AS specification FROM mes_production_defect d LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.execution_code=d.execution_code LEFT JOIN workorder w ON w.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id WHERE d.id IN #{id}

SELECT t.id AS eventId, SUM(CASE WHEN d.status=#{posted} AND d.document_type IN (#{defectReceipt},#{scrapReceipt}) AND ((d.document_type=#{defectReceipt} AND w.warehouse_type=#{defective}) OR (d.document_type=#{scrapReceipt} AND w.warehouse_type=#{scrap})) AND o.source=#{local} AND w.source=#{local} AND d.source_execution_code IS NULL AND d.source_workorder_id IS NULL AND d.post_request_id=t.id AND d.posted_by=t.operator_user_id AND d.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND l.quantity=t.transfer_qty AND t.transfer_qty>0 AND t.returned_qty=0 AND l.warehouse_id=t.target_warehouse_id AND l.material_id=e.product_id AND l.unit_id=m.unit_id AND a.id=l.stock_action_id AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.operation_id=t.id AND a.operation_id=d.post_request_id AND a.execution_code=t.execution_code AND a.action_type=#{otherReceipt} AND a.source_type=#{receiptSource} AND a.source_id=CAST(d.id AS CHAR) AND a.reference_action_id IS NULL AND a.stock_id=l.stock_id AND a.material_id=l.material_id AND a.unit_id=l.unit_id AND a.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND a.quantity_delta=l.quantity AND a.available_delta=l.quantity AND a.quantity_after-a.quantity_before=l.quantity AND a.available_after-a.available_before=l.quantity AND a.operator_user_id=d.posted_by AND a.request_hash=d.post_request_hash
AND CAST(a.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(a.batch_no)=OCTET_LENGTH(l.batch_no) AND CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(e.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(l.batch_no)=OCTET_LENGTH(e.batch_no) AND ((CAST(a.bin_code AS BINARY(256))=CAST(l.bin_code AS BINARY(256)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(a.bin_code)=OCTET_LENGTH(l.bin_code)) OR (a.bin_code IS NULL AND l.bin_code IS NULL)) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_document_line other_line WHERE other_line.document_id=d.id)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_action other_action WHERE other_action.document_line_id=l.id)=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_quality_treatment other_event WHERE other_event.stock_document_id=d.id)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS validCount FROM mes_quality_treatment t LEFT JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=t.stock_document_id LEFT JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id LEFT JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.execution_code=t.execution_code LEFT JOIN workorder o ON o.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id=t.target_warehouse_id WHERE t.execution_code=#{executionCode} AND t.action_type=#{transferWarehouse} GROUP BY t.id
